description: Creative work is judged by how it looks and feels: a finished style frame replaces the grey wireframe, tickets name the brief fit and the feedback on every action, and a palette is tokens, not a test of pixel counts.

opinions.summary: A ticket that changes how a screen looks gets one finished frame in the real palette under docs/design/<ticket>/, rendered by screenshot --wireframe and approved by the owner before screens are built on it.
A creative ticket says how the change serves the verbatim brief.
A creative ticket names, for each player action or event, the visual, motion and sound feedback.
A creative ticket says what a viewer must understand within a few seconds, and its time-to-first-interaction budget.
Colours come from tokens, and a palette is a set of tokens; no test asserts pixel counts or exact shades.
Review flags a test that locks a style choice (a palette size, a pixel shade, a font) instead of a behaviour.
Motion respects the viewer's reduced-motion setting.
Nothing from an existing work is reproduced: references set a mood, they are not copied.
